mapper.sql: select id, student_id, avatar, push_flag, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from cf_checkin
mapper.select:
SELECT ci.id, ci.student_id, cs.`name` as student_name, cs.dept_id, sd.dept_name, ci.avatar, ci.push_flag, ci.create_time FROM cf_checkin ci LEFT JOIN cf_student cs on cs.id = ci.student_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept sd on sd.dept_id = cs.dept_id
and ci.push_flag = #{pushFlag} and DATE(ci.create_time) = CURDATE() and cs.dept_id = #{deptId}
and date_format(ci.create_time,'%Y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.beginTime},'%Y%m%d')
and date_format(ci.create_time,'%Y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.endTime},'%Y%m%d')
and cs.`name` like concat('%', #{studentName}, '%')
order by ci.create_time desc

SELECT cs.dept_id AS deptId, sd.dept_name AS deptName, COUNT(DISTINCT ci.student_id) AS count FROM cf_checkin ci LEFT JOIN cf_student cs ON cs.id = ci.student_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept sd ON sd.dept_id = cs.dept_id WHERE DATE(ci.create_time) = CURDATE() AND (ci.del_flag IS NULL OR ci.del_flag = '0') GROUP BY cs.dept_id, sd.dept_name ORDER BY sd.dept_name

SELECT ci.avatar, '签到' AS checkType, cs.name AS studentName, DATE_FORMAT(ci.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, IFNULL(sd.dept_name, '') AS school, COALESCE(NULLIF(cs.family, ''), '打卡') AS project FROM cf_checkin ci LEFT JOIN cf_student cs ON cs.id = ci.student_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept sd ON cs.dept_id = sd.dept_id WHERE ci.id = #{id} AND (ci.del_flag IS NULL OR ci.del_flag = '0')

SELECT ci.id, cs.`name` as student_name, ci.student_id, ci.avatar, ci.push_flag, ci.create_time FROM cf_checkin ci LEFT JOIN cf_student cs ON cs.id = ci.student_id WHERE ci.student_id = #{studentId} AND DATE(ci.create_time) = CURDATE() AND (ci.del_flag IS NULL OR ci.del_flag = '0') ORDER BY ci.create_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ci.id, cs.`name` as student_name, ci.student_id, ci.avatar, ci.push_flag, ci.create_time FROM cf_checkin ci INNER JOIN cf_student cs ON cs.id = ci.student_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT student_id, MAX(create_time) AS max_time FROM cf_checkin WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND (del_flag IS NULL OR del_flag = '0') GROUP BY student_id ) latest ON latest.student_id = ci.student_id AND latest.max_time = ci.create_time WHERE DATE(ci.create_time) = CURDATE() AND (ci.del_flag IS NULL OR ci.del_flag = '0')
AND cs.`name` LIKE concat('%', #{studentName}, '%')
ORDER BY ci.create_time DESC

SELECT ci.id AS checkinId, ci.student_id AS studentId, cs.name AS studentName, cs.dept_id AS deptId, sd.dept_name AS deptName, ci.avatar AS avatar, ci.create_time AS checkinTime FROM cf_checkin ci INNER JOIN cf_student cs ON cs.id = ci.student_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept sd ON sd.dept_id = cs.dept_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT student_id, MAX(create_time) AS max_time FROM cf_checkin WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND (del_flag IS NULL OR del_flag = '0') GROUP BY student_id ) latest ON latest.student_id = ci.student_id AND latest.max_time = ci.create_time WHERE DATE(ci.create_time) = CURDATE() AND (ci.del_flag IS NULL OR ci.del_flag = '0') AND (cs.del_flag IS NULL OR cs.del_flag = '0') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM cf_checkout co WHERE co.student_id = ci.student_id AND DATE(co.create_time) = CURDATE() AND (co.del_flag IS NULL OR co.del_flag = '0') )
AND cs.dept_id = #{deptId}
AND cs.name LIKE concat('%', #{studentName}, '%')
ORDER BY cs.name, ci.create_time DESC

SELECT cs.id AS studentId, cs.name AS studentName, cs.avatar AS avatar, cs.dept_id AS deptId, sd.dept_name AS deptName FROM cf_student cs LEFT JOIN sys_dept sd ON sd.dept_id = cs.dept_id WHERE (cs.del_flag IS NULL OR cs.del_flag = '0') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM cf_checkin ci WHERE ci.student_id = cs.id AND DATE(ci.create_time) = CURDATE() AND (ci.del_flag IS NULL OR ci.del_flag = '0') )
AND cs.dept_id = #{deptId}
AND cs.name LIKE concat('%', #{studentName}, '%')
ORDER BY cs.name
